Description
If you are an investor that would like to get a foot in the door of long term precious metal investment, then one of your first stops should be a monster box. These ultra-secure boxes provide a means to store up to 500, 1 ounce silver coins, totaling 500 ounces of .999 silver, with each coin having a troy ounce of pure silver. While many people will not be willing to put forth such a large investment into silver, the silver monster box still represents a great starting point for serious investments Each of the coins shows on the obverse a Likeness of Paul Kruger, South Africa’s first president, along with “South Africa” in Afrikaans and on the reverse is pictured the  springbok antelope, the national animal of South Africa, along with the year of minting, face value and silver weight
Not only will you be able to get a full starter set of coins with this monster silver box, but you will have a protective case that is perfect for keeping it all in one safe place.
Coin Highlights:
Contains 500 oz of .999 fine Silver.
To commemorate the Golden Jubilee celebrations, the
South African Mint
added the silver bullion coin to its portfolio.
Eligible for
Precious Metals IRAs.
Obverse: Likeness of Paul Kruger, South Africa’s first and only president
Reverse: A springbok antelope, the national animal of South Africa, along with the year of minting, face value and silver weight
You may also be interested in similar products such as
1 oz American Eagle Silver Coin.
